item.title: Securinets CTF Quals 2025 - Puzzle
item.description:
Securinets CTF Quals 2025 - Puzzle

Author: ToonExodia()

Puzzle involves needing to register as an editor by modifying the POST request when we log in, after which you make a publish a blog post with the admin as a collaborator. Reading the html, we can then see that we can accept the collaboration request on behalf of the admin. Doing so allows us to see the admins uuid, which allows us to see the admin password when we access /users/<uuid>. Logging in as admin, we see a ban user button, but after reading the provided code, its obvious that this is not the intended solve due to the blacklist of characters. After some further enumeration of the provided code, we see that we can access /data whcih allows us to download dbconnect.exe and secrets.zip. After that, all we need to do is the classic strings dbconnect.exe | grep pass which gives us a password that we can use to unzip secrets.zip and get the flag.

item.title: HTB - Craft
item.description:
HTB - Craft

Author: ToonExodia()

Craft is a medium-difficulty Linux box that begins with exploring a public Git service called gogs. This box demonstrates a full attack chain involving an eval() injection vulnerability in a Python API, SQL credential extraction, database enumeration, and lateral movement via exposed SSH keys. Privilege escalation is achieved using a misconfigured Vault setup that allows one-time SSH login as root.

Enumeration

Initial Scan 

nmap -sCV -v -p- 10.10.10.110

item.title: HTB - Outbound
item.description:
HTB - Outbound

Author: ToonExodia()

Outbound is a easy-difficulty Linux box that starts with credentials to access a Roundcube webmail instance. The box demonstrates a chain of vulnerabilities including CVE-2025-49113 (Roundcube RCE), database credential extraction, password decryption, and privilege escalation via CVE-2025-27591 by using the Below monitoring tool.

Enumeration

Initial TCP Scan 

nmap -sCV -v -p- 10.10.11.77

The scan shows:

  • SSH (22/tcp)
  • HTTP (80/tcp): With redirect to mail.outbound.htb

Make sure to add the hostname/redirect to /etc/hosts:
